definitions.explanation: A house or dwelling that is available for rent. Distinguished from apartments or single rooms.

examples.japanese: この{辺|あた}りに{貸家|かしや}はありますか。
examples.english: Are there any houses for rent around here?

examples.japanese: {貸家|かしや}の{家賃|やちん}は{月|つき}10{万円|まんえん}です。
examples.english: The rent for the rental house is 100,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{貸家|かしや}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for an old house for rent.

notes:
ALTERNATIVE READING: Also read as かしいえ, but かしや is more common.

SIGNS:
・「{貸家|かしや}」 (House for Rent)
・「{貸家|かしや}{募集|ぼしゅう}」 (Rental house available)

RELATED TERMS:
・{貸間|かしま} (room for rent)
・{賃貸|ちんたい}{住宅|じゅうたく} (rental housing - formal)
・{借家|しゃくや} (rented house - from tenant's perspective)
・{持|も}ち{家|いえ} (owned home - opposite)

CONTRAST:
・{貸家|かしや} (renting out - owner's perspective)
・{借家|しゃくや} (renting - tenant's perspective)

NOTE: In real estate contexts, {賃貸|ちんたい}{一戸建|いっこだ}て (rental single-family house) is often used in modern listings.
